name: Terabyte Plus Public Company Limited
summary: Operating from its base in Bangkok, Thailand, Terabyte Plus Public Company Limited furnishes a wide range of information technology solutions. The company's offerings encompass a variety of cloud-based and continuous services, including Infrastructure-as-a-Service (IaaS), ERP hosted on the cloud, Virtual Desktop Infrastructure (VDI) on the cloud, and other related provisions. Furthermore, they supply on-site hardware and robust cybersecurity measures, addressing critical areas such as identity and access control, endpoint defense, network safeguarding, data loss prevention, reliable backup and recovery systems, and compliance with regulations. For the logistics sector, they develop intelligent transport management software. To facilitate data-driven insights, Terabyte Plus delivers data analytics solutions and services, which include expert training consultations, data preparation, and business intelligence tools. The company was established in 2005.
